construct: Peutz-Jeghers syndrome is an autosomal dominant hamartomatous polyposis syndrome caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in STK11, a serine/threonine kinase tumor suppressor involved in cell polarity, growth control, and AMPK-related signaling.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Mucocutaneous pigmentation plus hamartomatous small-bowel polyps and intussusception is Peutz-Jeghers syndrome; the causative germline tumor-suppressor gene is STK11.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: APC and MUTYH cause adenomatous polyposis; MLH1 causes Lynch syndrome; SMAD4 can cause juvenile polyposis. None produces the classic PJS pigmentation-plus-hamartomatous-polyp phenotype.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The lead asks for the causal germline gene, and the phenotype is sufficiently specific that STK11 is the only matching option.
